title: FileZilla saved sites and passwords
whyItMatters: FileZilla can save FTP and SFTP logins, including passwords, in sitemanager.xml and recentservers.xml in this folder. A stranger could use them to reach the same servers.
source: FileZilla wiki, FileZilla Client data directory: %APPDATA%/FileZilla on Windows holds sitemanager.xml and recentservers.xml - https://wiki.filezilla-project.org/FileZilla_Client_Data_Directory
notes: Saved passwords may be obfuscated rather than encrypted, so they are readable. A portable install keeps its data next to the program instead. The folder also holds queue and layout state.

cleanup.exportFirst: Use File > Export in FileZilla to save the site list without passwords if you need the host names.
cleanup.signOut: Change the passwords of the FTP and SFTP accounts this PC connected to, because the saved copies keep working after the file is gone.
steps: Change the server account passwords at the hosting provider.
Uninstall FileZilla from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the saved site list and passwords from this PC. Server accounts keep working until their passwords are changed.
cleanup.source: FileZilla wiki, FileZilla Client data directory: https://wiki.filezilla-project.org/FileZilla_Client_Data_Directory
